description: This Java source file defines the PolicyConflictException class, a specific RuntimeException used within the Ditto framework to indicate conflicts when a policy with a given ID already exists. It includes mechanisms for building instances via a nested Builder class, and supports JSON-based instantiation and header management.

classes.name: PolicyConflictException
classes.description: A runtime exception indicating a conflict with existing policy when attempting to add a policy with an ID that already exists.
